## The steps {.light auto-animate=true background-color="#F5F2EA"}

::: {.big-title data-id="title" style="left:92px; top:104px; width:1100px; font-size:44px;"}
Draft, review, release.
:::

::: {.panel .card data-id="draft" style="left:96px; top:220px; width:340px; height:360px;"}
[Draft]{.h}

[Get a rough version in front of yourself fast. Perfect is later.]{.p}
:::
::: {.panel .card data-id="review" style="left:470px; top:220px; width:340px; height:360px;"}
[Review]{.h}

[A second pair of eyes catches what you have stopped seeing.]{.p}
:::
::: {.panel .card data-id="release" style="left:844px; top:220px; width:340px; height:360px;"}
[Release]{.h}

[Ship it, then watch how it behaves in the wild.]{.p}
:::

## On review {.light auto-animate=true background-color="#F5F2EA"}

::: {.big-title data-id="title" style="left:92px; top:104px; width:1100px; font-size:44px;"}
Reviewing is where quality happens.
:::

::: {.panel .card data-id="review" style="left:96px; top:200px; width:800px; height:400px;"}
[Review]{.h}

[Read it as if you did not write it. Ask what would confuse a newcomer, what is untested, and what you are quietly hoping no one notices.]{.p style="font-size:24px; line-height:1.6;"}
:::

:::
